unit: Full concrete Belyi/local compactness/height-conductor reduction of Fermat.CanonicalEstimate

correction_to_previous_design.claim_retracted: The actual local algebraic-closure carrier was unavailable at the platform Mathlib pin.
correction_to_previous_design.actual_carrier: PadicAlgCl 2 = AlgebraicClosure Q_2; its spectral norm; no arbitrary local field witness is supplied.

required_actual_data: PlaneAdjunctionData: actual nonzero rational function r with coefficient equality
PolarPresentation: exact difference of actual polar divisors
CuspGenerators: actual finite coordinate-ring generator model containing the tripod functions
computed_functions: functionHeight from Mathlib normalized heights of actual rational values
divHeight R = functionHeight R.f - functionHeight R.g
logCondOf from actual finite places, evaluated generators, and full point-field degree

new_children.name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.localCompactness
new_children.full_type_expansion: forall {N} (M : Model N), PlacesDiscrete M -> ResiduesFinite M -> forall d (xs : Nat -> QbarPoint M.K), (forall n, (xs n).degree <= d) -> exists s, StrictMono s and exists T : Finset (Place M.K), forall phi, phi != 0 -> phi != 1 -> (forall P in T, phi and phi^-1 and (phi-1)^-1 belong to P.O) -> exists c, eventually n, LocalBounds M (xs(s n)) phi c
new_children.fidelity: Every embedding into actual PadicAlgCl 2 and Complex is bounded. Proper places include infinity. A finite point degree bound is essential; Qbar_2 itself is not locally compact.

new_children.name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.avoidanceRegularity
new_children.full_type_expansion: forall {N} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) phi P, P notin cusps M hDVR phi -> phi in P.O and phi^-1 in P.O and (phi-1)^-1 in P.O
new_children.fidelity: Concrete normalized valuation statement, not a selected good-place predicate.

new_children.name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.embeddingBoundsToSet
new_children.full_type_expansion: forall {N} (M : Model N), ResiduesFinite M -> forall x phi d c, x.degree <= d -> LocalBounds M x phi c -> belyiImage M phi x in (localCompactSet d c).set
new_children.fidelity: One common valuation set V={2}, bound (d+1)*max(c,0), for all selected images. Must prove image-field embedding extension and local-degree scaling.

new_children.name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.canonicalHeightIdentification
new_children.full_type_expansion: forall {N} M hDVR, 3<N -> ResiduesFinite M -> forall A (K : CanonicalDivisorData M hDVR) (H : InfinityDivisorData M hDVR), PlaneAdjunctionData M hDVR K H -> forall RK : PolarPresentation M hDVR K.D, exists C, forall p : Fermat.Pt N, abs(divHeight RK (affineLift M A p)-Fermat.canonicalHeight p) <= C
new_children.source: Actual plane adjunction div(du)~(N-3)H, Height tuple evaluation and principal-divisor bounded discrepancy; independent adaptation of Heights.Curve.DivisorHeight and Genl/Curves/Covering.lean:451-454
new_children.fidelity: Explicitly consumes actual K,H,nonzero-r adjunction and actual polar presentation. This is where the fixed (N-3)*normalized[U:V:1] height is identified with the canonical Weil height; it is not treated as proved by naming it canonicalHeight.

new_children.name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.belyiHeightRelation
new_children.full_type_expansion: forall {N} M hDVR hRF A phi, IsBelyi M hDVR phi -> forall hfin (B : ArithmeticDivisorChoices M hDVR phi hfin), exists C, forall p, GoodValue M (affineLift M A p) phi -> abs(divHeight B.canonicalPresentation (affineLift M A p)+divHeight B.cuspPresentation (affineLift M A p)-Tripod.htCan(belyiImage M phi (affineLift M A p))) <= C
new_children.source: Genl/Curves/BelyiDescent.lean:215-237 divHeight_logCanon_add_cusp; :313-315; actual Belyi relation and tripod height comparison
new_children.fidelity: Uses actual div(du) and actual reduced cusp divisor. Does not define cusp height as imageHeight-canonicalHeight.

new_children.name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.divisorDegreeHeightComparison
new_children.full_type_expansion: forall {N} M hDVR hRF (D E : Divisor M) (RD : PolarPresentation M hDVR D) (RE : PolarPresentation M hDVR E) q, 0<divisorDegree M D -> (divisorDegree M E : Real)<q*divisorDegree M D -> exists C, forall x : QbarPoint M.K, divHeight RE x <= q*divHeight RD x+C
new_children.actual_consumer: canonicalEstimate_of_belyi_children, with D=actual canonical divisor and E=actual cusp divisor
new_children.fidelity: The degree inequality is strict. There is no equality-at-degree-ratio assumption and no free real-valued height parameter.

new_children.name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.belyiDifferentConductorComparison
new_children.full_type_expansion: forall {N} M hDVR hRF A phi, IsBelyi M hDVR phi -> forall hfin (G : CuspGenerators M hDVR phi hfin), exists C, forall p, GoodValue M (affineLift M A p) phi -> Tripod.logDiff(image p)+Tripod.logCond(image p) <= Fermat.logDiff p+logCondOf M hRF G.G (affineLift M A p)+C
new_children.fidelity: Every discriminant/conductor uses its actual point-field normalization; AffineIdentification.field_eq and belyiImage_field_le are the field bridges. G generates the actual coordinate ring and contains phi,phi^-1,(1-phi)^-1.

new_children.name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.cuspConductorHeightComparison
new_children.full_type_expansion: forall {N} M hDVR hRF A phi, IsBelyi M hDVR phi -> forall hfin (G : CuspGenerators M hDVR phi hfin) (RE : PolarPresentation M hDVR (cuspDivisor M hDVR phi hfin)), exists C, forall p, GoodValue M (affineLift M A p) phi -> logCondOf M hRF G.G (affineLift M A p) <= divHeight RE (affineLift M A p)+C
new_children.fidelity: Actual finite-place affine-model conductor and actual effective cusp-divisor height, not interchangeable supplied functions.

reused_open_children.note: All are explicitly imported/consumed by Sol_FermatCanonicalEstimate. The two existing compositions only assemble concrete mathematical data, not comparison laws.

local_composition.name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.boundedBelyiImages_of_children
local_composition.output: For every sequence of actual Fermat points with degree<=d, an actual IsBelyi phi, a StrictMono subsequence s, one Tripod.CompactlyBounded K, and good evaluation/membership/image-degree<=d for every selected term.
local_composition.proof: The finite limit places from compactness are avoided by the actual Belyi function. Passing to an explicit tail preserves strict monotonicity. The original degree bound is preserved via actual image-field inclusion.

parent_composition.name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.canonicalEstimate_of_belyi_children
parent_composition.proof: Assume failure at degree<=d and tolerance epsilon. Choose xs with discrepancy>n. Select actual Belyi phi and compact subsequence. Choose actual canonical/infinity/adjunction/polar/generator data. canonicalDivisorDegree proves positive actual canonical degree N(N-3). Choose q=max(degE/degK,0)+1, hence actual StrictQ and q>0. Set delta=epsilon/(1+q*(1+epsilon)), so 1+delta=(1+epsilon)*(1-delta*q). StatementII on the selected images plus the five genuine comparison children gives H<= (1+delta)Diff + delta*q*H+C. StrictMono s implies s(n)>=n; choose n>C/(1-delta*q) to contradict the original failure sequence.
parent_composition.no_parent_renaming: No child is NoncriticalInput->CanonicalEstimate, StatementII->CanonicalEstimate, or a freely chosen height theory. Every remaining comparison has actual geometric/rational/divisor/arithmetic inputs and a distinct source theorem.

strict_q_and_normalization.canonical_degree_identity: Independently supplied canonicalDivisorDegree on the true div(du), actual infinity divisor and actual adjunction witness.
strict_q_and_normalization.canonical_height_identity: Independently open canonicalHeightIdentification relates the true canonical divisor height to the fixed existing Fermat canonicalHeight.
strict_q_and_normalization.strict_q: The proof uses actual degE<q*degK, derived from StrictQ plus the explicit canonical-degree identity. Equality at degree ratio is never used.
strict_q_and_normalization.point_fields: The original Fermat logDiff uses Q(u,v), image logDiff uses Q(phi(p)), and logCondOf uses the full point field. The explicit comparison theorem must prove the normalized tower inequality across those actual fields.
